notes.title: Fruitbus Patch 1.0.14
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, new patch incoming! One final patch for PC before Fruitbus releases on Xbox and Nintendo Switch in a little over a week! Lots of exciting Fruitbus stuff happening August 7th ^^. As always, if you experience issues over any platform don't hesitate to let us know by filing a bug report either on the Steam forums or Discord. 



Here are our new fixes! 


Minor Fixes
Fixed an issue where a few flatpacks were missing icons in the flatpack storage unit.

Fixed an issue where the backpack aim marker did not acknowledge the windmill interior.

Balancing: Added more wheat spawning in the windmill surroundings.

Fixed background music not playing in memory cutscenes.
Visual
Updated the games credits
Tweaks
General interactions have been moved from bumpers to triggers

notes.title: Fruitbus Patch 1.0.12
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!


Happy summer, we’re back with an update for Fruitbus! It's been a while since we've done a substantial patch, and it certainly hasn't been for the lack of wanting to. 



Among a few minor quality of life improvements, we've focused on some long standing bugs like where people lose important items or get their truck permanently stuck, and we really hope we've alleviated the worst cases for some of these, so please don't hesitate to let us know by filing a bug report either on the Steam forums or Discord if you keep experiencing issues.



We are eternally grateful to all of you who have helped us with the quest to crush bugs by sharing info, saves and logs, which have been more than crucial in finding the root cause of any and all issues. Your continued support of the game is heartwarming.



Not only that, but the feedback we receive is so incredibly helpful and thoughtful, and we really hope to have the resources to keep fixing things and making the game better.



The game will likely not have many huge updates or features added, but we have every intention to continue fixing bugs and improving the experience of Fruitbus.


Alright, let’s get rolling on the new features!


Save Backups 
You can now reset a save slot to an earlier version! To access this feature, click on Save Slots from the main menu. Then select the green icon. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/33936c1dbffe7b1bbf6234a05f96e9dcfb07568f.png"]

And from there, scroll through your list of previous saves. Date and times of your saves are already there. And yes, this does work on save data prior to the patch ^^

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/967087276679b0dbc9c74df71b74a422ab77eba1.png"]


Tool Quick Swap 
You can now seamlessly swap tools from your backpack. Selecting a tool slot already in use will now swap the currently held tool with the tool in the occupied backpack slot! We’re hoping this makes your expeditions even smoother! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/ca424f18b5c7196b7b1c97cc86b5bfef58281f3c.png"] 

Thanks again for your engagement and support! We could not have done this without you. You can read the rest of the patch notes below! 

Fruitbus Patch Notes 1.0.12

Features
Save backups: You can now reset a save slot to an earlier version.

Tool quick swapping: Placing a held tool in a backpack slot that is occupied will swap the two tools.


Major Fixes
Fixed an issue where the truck could get stuck with the wheels half through the ground, and the Unstuck function didn’t work.

Fixed an issue where occasional opening of the backpack would offset the backpack’s position and delete the tool the player was holding.

Fixed an issue where it was possible to make soups from smoothies, but the smoothie would not stop spinning in the pot. Soup is now only possible to make by adding water and ingredients.

Implemented a fix to avoid incidents of objects breaking and falling through the world or otherwise disappearing inexplicably. 

Fixed an issue where the dough machine would not produce dough, nor reset if too much water was added.


Quests & Game Flow
Clarified quest text about the banana topper and returning to Morris.

Fixed an issue where quest NPCs were getting stuck on the Time Capsule by the volcano in Banamas.


Tweaks & Minor Fixes
Performance
Implemented a fix to avoid sudden camera rotations caused by lag spikes.

Fixed an issue where loading the Saves menu was slow due to large amounts of backup saves.


Localization
Fixed an issue where voice lines in certain languages got cut off too early, and a line of chinese voice that had snuck in between one of the japanese voice lines.

Fixed a number of minor typos in Norwegian localization.

Updated the French localization of “shoot” for the Fruitfetcher.


Visual
Fixed an issue where the Blender and Flatpacker buttons could increase in size for each time they were packed and unpacked.

Fixed an issue where players could get stuck behind an invisible wall at the Villa gates in Breezy Bay.

Added bricks to the previously hovering truck in the tutorial scrapyard.


Functional
Fixed an issue where Playstation 5 controllers were not detected as supported by the game and was invoking Steam input.

Fixed an issue where typing the letter “R” when renaming dishes would open the backpack.

Fixed an issue where objects were not highlighted when targeted by the backpack.

Fixed an issue where the money from a star near the volcano kept falling through the rocks.

Slightly reduced eruption time of the volcano, and increased the time it takes for the Chilis to despawn so that they are harder to miss out on.

Brought an end to a repetitious potato conversation on the radio.

notes.title: Fruitbus Patch Notes 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Fruitbus 1.0.3 incoming with more fixes and a new feature! Thank you again to everyone who has helped us test, here are the new updates.

Features

 Hold to chop! While holding a knife, you can now hold the chop button to keep chopping. Hold to chop can be toggled on and off in the gameplay settings.


Major Fixes

Quests & Game Flow

 Fixed not being able to travel to Frosty Pines after the story is completed
 Fixed quest bugs for Coco, Larper Dart and Explorer

Saving & Loading

 No more floating fruits on load
 Radio towers now save the state of their parts
 The windmill cog saves its state and will no longer reappear if dug up but not placed in the windmill
 Fixed saves breaking if saving with a full fuel tank

Other

 No more missing fruit after Farewell Feast
 Fixed invert camera setting only affecting gamepad
 Fixed pausing being during loading screens breaking things
 Fixed a case where the journal could get stuck on screen
 Fixed console commands not working
 The truck no longer falls if the ground underneath it is unloaded
 Fixed music not being affected by the music volume setting
 Removed Gobo Gobo


Tweaks

 Can no longer make smoothies with wheat
 Bread and Soup methods are now added to the journal when the quests that introduce them start.
 Explorer mission's objectives grouped better together in the journal
 Can no longer remove truck parts that can't be replaced (hood, engine, wheels, etc)
 Added radio static to more Banamas tunnels
 Tweaked tool magnet rotations for harpoons
 Tools now snap instantly into position on the tool magnet
 Teddy is now spawnable via console commands on release builds
 Player now returns to banamas ferry dock when the Farewell Feast has finished
 Pausing or opening journal is no longer possible during Farewell Feast credits
 Updated Xbox & Playstation button icons
 Updated credits
 Various visual upgrades made to main menu
 Various localization tweaks


Minor Fixes

 The lucky coin can now be placed in the backpack
 Fixed ferry paint color not being saved
 Character eyes no longer disappears when you are far away from them
 Ingredients in soup should no longer get highlighted.
 Highlighting on Cups and Jugs no longer obscures the liquid.
 Adjusted various environment assets that we're either buried or hovering
 Lord Edge quest icon fixed
 Fixed badly aligned text in journal mission view
 Fixed icons for paint buckets
 Fixed some exterior customization objects breaking customization
 Flatpack Flatpacker now properly resizes names of stored items
 Fixed some tools breaking if placed in backpack mid-animation
 Fixed some cases where grandma's urn in the truck seat may have had lingering effects after loading
 Player Unstuckifier now clears override loading screen
 Journal Update notification playing correct audio
 Fixed snow not disappearing when loading into completed FP storm quest state. Moved responsibility from weather script to logic script.
 Fixed visual artifacts from low anisotropic filtering on road textures
 Blocked handbrake interaction in situations where the truck really needs to stay still

notes.title: Fruitbus Patch: Saving Issue Fix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, quick patch incoming. 

There have been some comments of people not being able to save properly in Fruitbus. 

This issue should now be resolved and saving should be safe for everyone. 

This issue was caused by an outdated “manifest" file, created from those playing a version of the demo older than the most recent Next Fest demo. This fix upgrades your old save file to a new one. So now people who played on older demos should be able to save/load just fine.

Apologies to everyone affected by this.

If you are one of the people affected, please reach out to us through our Discord. We want to extend a small token as our apology <3. 

If you run into any issues please don’t hesitate to let us know. You can report bugs either through our Discord forum or through our Steam forums. 

More updates coming very soon!
